name: Dranzer MS
description: Dranzer MS: a Balance phoenix with two unique abilities and one Special.

ability.name: Metal Phoenix Edge
ability.description: Successful Attacks ignore 10% enemy DEF. Deals additional damage equal to 8% ATK.

special_move.name: Metal Phoenix Ascension
special_move.description: Base damage: 175 + 75% ATK. Ignores 20% enemy DEF. Gains 1% additional damage for every 2% maximum HP missing. Maximum additional damage bonus: 35%. Cooldown: 5 rounds.

abilities.name: Metal Phoenix Edge
abilities.description: Successful Attacks ignore 10% enemy DEF. Deals additional damage equal to 8% ATK.

abilities.name: Final Phoenix Spirit
abilities.description: For every 20% maximum HP lost, gain: 5% ATK. 4% DEF. Maximum bonus: 20% ATK and 16% DEF. Bonuses are recalculated based on current HP.
